actions.reason: The 89-member set has an interpretable mutation phenotype (PBRM1 enrichment OR 22.68, q_driver=0.0061; VHL depletion OR 0.031, q_driver=0.0013), but this is only driver-panel-level and does not establish independent retention. Its boundary against the only neighboring set K5_C0004 is broadly unsupported: the pair affinity-geometry report shows weak, largely non-separating native-view evidence (CT silhouette -0.032 with 78.6% negative, RNA 0.0014, WSI -0.0057, WXS 0.0734 with within>between), and the partition structural screen shows the nearest-pair between-set affinity (0.108) below both within-set affinities. The set's own structural screen reports candidate_k=1 with no dominant subdivision signal and only modest, weakly separated feasible splits, so no supported split rescues it. With the boundary to the sole neighbor unresolved and merge-compatible, and no remaining evidence that could establish independence, the candidate lacks defensible discovery value.

The 14-member set has a coherent transcriptomic phenotype (EMT NES 2.34 q=0.001, Hedgehog 1.96 q=0.0021, angiogenesis 1.70 q=0.0074, with concordant OXPHOS/ROS/MYC down-regulation), but biological identity alone does not establish subtype independence. Its membership representation is weak and partially degenerate: the set affinity-geometry report shows only small positive native-view separations (CT 0.031, RNA 0.020, WSI 0.009) and a degenerate WXS silhouette of 1.0 reflecting identical members rather than graded separation. Its boundary against the only neighboring set is weak and non-separating (pair report: CT -0.032, RNA 0.0014, WSI -0.0057, WXS 0.0734 with within>between), and the partition screen shows between-set affinity below both within-set affinities. With the sole relevant boundary unresolved and merge-compatible, and no supported split available, the candidate lacks defensible discovery value.
